T1 2-N16 TRIMMERS EACH SIDE OF OPENING
CLASS D ACCESS COVER TO AS 3996,
1. ALL DIMENSIONS IN MILLIMETRES AND LEVELS IN METRES (AHD) UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE.
2. CONCRETE N40. COVER TO REINFORCEMENT 50 UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE.
4. LAP LENGTHS 50d MINIMUM UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE.
5. BAR DIMENSIONS ARE TO BAR CENTRELINE. MINIMUM INTERNAL BEND DIAMETER 5d (AS 3600 TABLE
6. REINFORCEMENT INTERRUPTED BY OPENINGS SHALL BE CUT AND TRIMMER BARS PROVIDED AS SHOWN.
7. PIPE PENETRATIONS SHALL BE SEALED WITH NON-SHRINK GROUT AND FLEXIBLE JOINT TO PIPE
8. COG = STANDARD 90° COG TO AS 3600 CL 13.1.2.7, LENGTH AS SCHEDULED (SHORTENED WHERE LIMITED
BY SLAB DEPTH). SLAB BARS COGGED AT BOTH ENDS (BOTTOM BARS UP, TOP BARS DOWN); WALL VERTICAL
9. PRECAST MANHOLE COMPONENTS TO WSA 02 / AUTHORITY STANDARD DRAWINGS AND MANUFACTURER'S
10. DRAFT GENERATED BY LYNHCADTOOLSBOX - TO BE CHECKED BY THE DESIGN ENGINEER.
